text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes. I sent you the full list with sources in a thread reply to your message.

1. #PD-4492 comes from Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18) weren't getting text messages telling them their bay at the gatehouse check-in. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct early-morning shift got through fine. The note also says the Eau Claire check-in logs should be archived before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.

2. #4419 comes from Moss's "North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea also logged this one: barcode scanners at the gatehouse weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. It was escalated to second-level product support to test the scanner software. The note has no date and doesn't say whether it was fixed.

The two tickets look alike and both involve Door 14, but they're separate problems (text messages vs. scanners), so keep them apart in the weekly notes. I checked all six of Moss's notes in the shared files and found no other ticket numbers for this account. #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in Moss's Central handoff note belong to a Central team account, not this one. Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a customer, and Moss didn't write it.
